selection_criteria: direct relevance to quant/trading or MQL5 (C++-family) engineering
coverage of every xauusd-factory pipeline stage
production safety (security, risk, debugging) over breadth
prefer one representative when the catalog has namespaced duplicates

agents.name: quant-analyst
agents.why: Core edge design: signal statistics, expectancy, walk-forward plan, overfitting guards for gold.
agents.one_liner: Build financial models, backtest trading strategies, and analyze market data.

agents.name: risk-manager
agents.why: Position sizing from equity risk %, R-multiples, daily loss cap and equity kill-switch rules.
agents.one_liner: Monitor portfolio risk, R-multiples, and position limits.

agents.name: search-specialist
agents.why: Gold market structure research: USD/real-yield drivers, session behaviour, news calendar, broker spread/contract specs.
agents.one_liner: Expert web researcher using advanced search techniques and synthesis.

agents.name: data-scientist
agents.why: Regime detection, volatility clustering checks, sample-size sanity and statistical validation of backtest output.
agents.one_liner: Expert data scientist for advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling.

agents.name: cpp-pro
agents.why: MQL5 is C++-derived; idiomatic structure, RAII-style handle lifecycle, safe arithmetic and performance-aware OnTick code.
agents.one_liner: Write idiomatic C++ code with modern features, RAII, smart pointers, and STL algorithms.

agents.name: c-pro
agents.why: Low-level correctness review: integer/double conversions, array bounds, memory-free hot path in OnTick.
agents.one_liner: Write efficient C code with proper memory management, pointer arithmetic, and system calls.

agents.name: backend-development-security-auditor
agents.why: Audit EA attack surface: no DLL/WebRequest, input validation, credential hygiene, safe failure modes.
agents.one_liner: Review code and architecture for security vulnerabilities, OWASP Top 10, auth flaws, and compliance issues.

agents.name: threat-modeling-expert
agents.why: Threat model for live trading: broker execution risk, slippage/requotes, runaway order loops, VPS compromise.
agents.one_liner: Expert in threat modeling methodologies, security architecture review, and risk assessment.

agents.name: comprehensive-review-code-reviewer
agents.why: Production-reliability code review of the .mq5 before any live deployment.
agents.one_liner: Elite code review expert specializing in modern AI-powered code analysis, security vulnerabilities, performance optimization, and production reliability.

agents.name: debugging-toolkit-debugger
agents.why: Diagnose MetaEditor compile errors and Strategy Tester journal failures (retcodes, invalid stops).
agents.one_liner: Debugging specialist for errors, test failures, and unexpected behavior.

agents.name: error-debugging-error-detective
agents.why: Parse Experts/Journal logs for recurring trade errors and anomaly patterns across test runs.
agents.one_liner: Search logs and codebases for error patterns, stack traces, and anomalies.

agents.name: python-pro
agents.why: Lightweight offline analysis: parse Strategy Tester CSV/HTML reports, proxy backtests without tick data.
agents.one_liner: Master Python 3.12+ with modern features, async programming, performance optimization, and production-ready practices.

agents.name: unit-testing-test-automator
agents.why: Regression test harness for the strategy logic port and reproducible tester configs.
agents.one_liner: Master AI-powered test automation with modern frameworks, self-healing tests, and comprehensive quality engineering.

agents.name: backend-development-performance-engineer
agents.why: Keep OnTick cheap: new-bar gating, cached indicator handles, minimal history scans.
agents.one_liner: Profile and optimize application performance including response times, memory usage, query efficiency, and scalability.

agents.name: code-documentation-docs-architect
agents.why: Turn strategy spec + audit + backtest into README and operator documentation.
agents.one_liner: Creates comprehensive technical documentation from existing codebases.
